_note: Read by blocks/b-qa-gate/check.py. Kinds used: qa_gate, duration_window, dims, luma_floor, loudness, mean_volume and perceptual (a look for the bot). Step 6 runs the top-level checks on saves/final_video.mp4; steps 1 and 4 run the two interim lists with --step.

checks.desc: (a) The background behind and around the speaker card is not black: real footage or a card is visible in every sample frame.
(b) The complete face shows in the speaker card, forehead to chin, not cropped at the top or bottom and not stretched.
(c) The speaker card is fully on screen with a clear gap below it (a 110 px margin) and a ring in the brand colour.
(d) Cards and captions occupy the upper zone only; nothing invades the bottom band where the speaker card sits.
(e) The background fills the full frame width: no side bars, no top or bottom bands, no distortion.
(f) Captions are legible, the emphasis words are in the brand accent, and no caption overlaps the speaker card.
(g) All captions and card text use Latin script only.
(h) Where the plan placed a b-roll clip, that clip is on screen; where it did not, a card is.
(i) Frame 0 shows the speaker card over a content beat (the planned money shot): not black, not a title card, not a fade.
